{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Summary of key findings from inspection
print("\n=== FINDINGS ===")
print(f"- {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()} rows have sentinel value -999 in baseline (11%)")
print(f"- {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()} duplicate patient_id entries (48 unique patients with multiple rows)")
print(f"- {len(dup_counts[dup_counts > 1])} patients have multiple sample_seq entries (24 patients, since 48 duplicates) - confirm: 48/2 = 24")
print(f"- assay_batch has two values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"- Max biomarker_final (raw) is {df['biomarker_final'].max()}, which is suspiciously high - likely uncorrected batch B")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print(f"- Patient with most sample_seq entries: {sample_seq_counts.max()}")
print(f"- Number of patients with 2 sample_seq entries: {sample_seq_counts.eq(2).sum()}")

# Confirm the number of re-tested patients
print(f"- Expected number of re-tested patients: 24 (since 48 duplicate rows, 1 per patient)")

# Check if any batch B final values are > 1000 (e.g., 747.0, 831.0) - these are likely in µg/L
batch_b_high = df[(df['assay_batch'] == 'B') & (df['biomarker_final'] > 100)]
print(f"- {len(batch_b_high)} batch B records with final biomarker > 100 ng/mL (likely in µg/L)")"}
